def pos(fr):
    d={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
        d.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)))
    return d
def chk(tag):
    p=pos(current_frame); N=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')[0].count('N')
    done=last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('game_over')
    print(tag,"bar",p.get('b'),"N",N,"done?",done)
    return done
d=chk("start")
if not d:
    r=action(['LEFT'], intent='explore'); d=chk("L1")
if not d:
    r=action(['LEFT','LEFT'], intent='explore'); d=chk("L3")
print("res:",{k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('no_impact','level_completed','game_over','done')})

</function>

<function=python>

def pos(fr):
    d={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
        d.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)))
    return d
def chk(tag):
    p=pos(current_frame); N=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')[0].count('N')
    done=last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('game_over')
    print(tag,"bar",p.get('b'),"N",N,"done?",done)
    return done
d=chk("start")
if not d:
    r=action(['LEFT'], intent='explore'); d=chk("L1")
if not d:
    r=action(['LEFT','LEFT'], intent='explore'); d=chk("L3")
print("res:",{k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('no_impact','level_completed','game_over','done')})
